title: Skeletal lich lord amid floating ruins in a purple void
description: An undead sorcerer-king reaches out before drifting gothic ruins, a dragon and violet storms; suits high-stakes, world-ending arcane campaigns.

title: Marble staircases with portal doors to many worlds
description: A smiling robed god-like figure beside endless marble stairways and golden doors that open onto a cave city, forest, desert pyramid and starship.

title: Harbor city market at dusk with a hooded rogue
description: A busy waterfront market below a hillside fortress and giant griffin statue, with ships, a treasure chest, mask and map; ideal for intrigue and urban heists.

title: Magical city plaza with a glowing portal arch
description: A fantastical cobbled square of tieflings, elves and small clockwork creatures, gambling halls, potion stalls and a portal arch showing a distant spired city.

title: Cavern laboratory beside a crashed vessel in snowy mountains
description: Steampunk lab with glowing tubes, a giant robot and explorers studying a wrecked metal ship wedged in an icy mountainside; for inventive, sci-fantasy mysteries.

title: Five-headed dragon above a burning ruined fortress
description: A colossal multi-headed dragon looms over a ruined citadel as robed cultists and adventurers clash among flames, banners and smaller wyverns.

title: Devil lord on a throne above an infernal landscape
description: A horned archdevil in crimson robes reclines on a skull throne overlooking lava rivers and ice cliffs, as chained captives are led past guards.

title: Mountain mining village above an aberration-haunted cave
description: A cozy lantern-lit village and mine at sunset, while tentacle-faced psionic aberrations lurk in a glowing purple cave beneath a strange standing stone.

title: Two-headed demon in a glowing underground cavern
description: Adventurers with a lantern face a tentacled, two-headed demon lord wading in a crystal-lit lake beneath a dark fortress and giant glowing mushrooms.

title: Tavern built around a huge bottomless well
description: Adventurers with torch and maps peer down a vast stone shaft in the middle of a warm, candlelit tavern; classic dungeon-delving starting point.

title: Dwarven underground ruins with a mad wizard and portal
description: Adventurers overlook carved dwarf-king statues, bridges, a hidden forest and a purple portal while a wild-eyed old wizard gestures from a wall.

title: Moonlit fey carnival with a fairy castle
description: A colorful circus and carousel under a full moon, with fairies, giant glowing mushrooms and a heart-shaped castle on a hill; whimsical fey adventures.

title: White dragon above a snowy peak with a ruined keep
description: A party of adventurers on a forested ridge watch a frost-breathing white dragon circle a mountain crowned with an old ruined castle.

title: Storm giant on coastal cliffs under lightning
description: A towering trident-wielding giant stands beside a party above stormy seas, with a cloud castle, blue dragon, fiery fortress and an icy giant citadel.

title: Jungle ruins with a pyramid, giant skull and volcano
description: Adventurers in dense jungle face an overgrown stepped pyramid, a skull-shaped cliff with waterfalls, a smoking volcano, a parrot and a predatory dinosaur.

title: Magical university campus with gardens and waterfalls
description: Young students with books and floating arcane shapes walk before a grand Gothic academy with banners, greenhouses and lily ponds; cheerful school setting.

title: Floating crystal city with bridges at night
description: A glowing spired city rests on a giant hovering crystal, linked by arched bridges and lantern-lit markets, with cherry blossoms and floating gems overhead.

title: Heist crew before a giant gilded strongroom door
description: A rogue picks a floor mechanism as companions hide beside guarded pedestals of crowns and gems, with laser-like tripwires and a magic key before a huge vault.

title: Vampire lord above a gothic castle under the moon
description: A cloaked vampire stands on a balcony overlooking a spired castle on a crag, a misty pine valley and a small lit village under a full moon.

title: Vast candlelit library tower beside sea cliffs
description: A towering library of spiral stairs, statues and glowing orbs with an open magic tome in the foreground and a castle on seaside cliffs beyond the window.

title: Dragon army besieging a walled coastal city
description: Red dragon, draconic soldiers and catapults assault a burning walled port city while a crowned skeletal knight with a greatsword watches from a rock.

title: Chained titan in sunken underwater ruins
description: Adventurers look up at a glowing, shackled giant figure seated amid drowned columns, banners and red crystals under shafts of sunlight.

title: Fishfolk village on a coral reef
description: Amphibious fish-people with tridents and nets tend docks and shell-roofed homes among coral and ruined arches while a sea monster swirls in the water above.

title: Frozen northern village under an aurora and ice spirit
description: Furred adventurers face a frozen lake and snowbound village as a huge horned frost spirit looms in the aurora-lit sky; bleak arctic survival setting.

title: Sailing ship through a starry nebula past floating ruins
description: Crew on a ship with iridescent sails gaze at planets, drifting marble ruins and a crystal city across a colorful nebula; for space-faring fantasy.

title: Stormy harbor town with a haunted mansion and sea monster
description: A rain-lashed fishing port, a ghostly green-lit mansion on a cliff, a ghost ship in the distance and a monster glowing beneath the waves.

title: Winged angel in a hellscape of war carts
description: A fiery armored angel stands over a lava-streaked infernal plain where horned demon troops pull spiked war wagons beneath a chained floating city.

title: Four elemental wizards at a ruined temple
description: Robed casters of fire, water, earth and air channel magic atop a ruined temple among waterfalls, lava, a tornado and hovering rocks.
